title: ColdManual Docset Manifest
description: Schema definition for a programming language or framework documentation manifest in ColdManual.

id.description: Unique lowercase identifier for the docset (e.g. 'python', 'qt', 'cpp').

description.description: Short 1-2 sentence description of the technology.

icon.description: Icon identifier or direct SVG/image URL.

latest_version.description: Version string representing the latest stable release (e.g. '3.13', '23').

latest_lts_version.description: Version string representing the latest active LTS release (e.g. '3.12', '6.8').

versions.description: List of available releases with lifecycle tags and download URLs.

is_lts.description: True if this version has Long-Term Support.

is_eol.description: True if this version has reached End-of-Life / is unsupported.

is_latest.description: True if this represents the current latest release.

download_url.description: Direct download link to the docset archive.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the archive for verification.
